knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson says to confirm each change against the official source and record the source, URL and date before acting. Updating straight away (option 0) and ignoring it (option 2) are ruled out, and social media is not a confirmed source.

The lesson says to verify the expiry date, record it and renew before it lapses, with a reminder set. Waiting for it to expire (option 0) and carrying on until someone notices (option 2) allow work without a valid licence.
The update and tell the team section says to tell the team and any subcontractor what has changed and when it takes effect.

practicalCriteria: Learner checks a supplied licence and insurance policy for currency, holder and scope, and records the expiry date.
Learner confirms a supplied rule change against an official source and records the source, URL and date checked.
Learner updates a supplied procedure and records that the team was told before the effective date.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Compliance register with sources, check dates and expiry dates
Change record showing the rule, effective date, procedures updated and team told
stopWorkCriteria: Learner accepts work when the licence or insurance has expired or does not cover the work
Learner acts on a rule change without checking it
